desc: Fast input parsing; choose block size S=max(1,min(N,int(N/sqrt(K)))); compute p=X//S, q=Y//S per query.
Offline P-row sweep: maintain H[j] over A-blocks, record P(p,Y) and C(p,q) for queries grouped by p via sorted events.
Symmetric Q-row sweep: maintain H2[i] over B-blocks, record Q(q,X) for queries grouped by q.
Tail-tail term: compute sum over i in [pS,X), j in [qS,Y) using sorted small arrays and two-pointer; combine ans = P_val + Q_val - C_val + tailtail.
Validate sample 1 and sample 2; edge cases (X<S, Y<S, empty tails, X=N/Y=N, ties, zeros, max values) and 64-bit arithmetic confirmed by passing public samples.
Implementation efficient (O(N sqrt K) sweeps, O(K S log S) tails), pure Python, reads stdin and writes stdout.
